hero.title: AION 2

aboutGame.title: What is AION 2?
paragraphs: AION 2 is a fantasy MMORPG developed by NC and set in Atreia. Play as a Daeva, explore on foot and in flight, and choose between the Elyos and Asmodians.
AION 2 combines class-based combat, character progression, cooperative dungeons, and faction PvP. Choose a class you enjoy, develop your build, and prepare for the Abyss.

finalCta.title: Ready to Master AION 2?
finalCta.description: From your first flight over Atreia to dungeon boss fights and Abyss battles, find a clear next step for your adventure.

footer.about: AION 2 Wiki is an independent fan-made guide to AION 2. Explore beginner guides, class builds, gear progression, dungeons, and Abyss PvP. This site is not affiliated with or endorsed by NC.
footer.description: A fantasy MMORPG of aerial exploration, class-based combat, cooperative dungeons, and Elyos-versus-Asmodian PvP.
